Meta Validation / Acceptance Criteria: The test polls MIZAR_MIPI_CSI2_HOST_PHY_STOPSTATE until value equals 0x1000f. For each of the 16 virtual channels and 129 iterations the DMA interrupt status is polled for bit 0 (control channel completion) and conditionally bit 1 (data channel completion). The control data read from 0xE6001000 is parsed: bits [5:0] determine data type and bits [21:6] determine word count. If data type > 0xF a CSI data DMA transfer is initiated. The test passes if all 16 x 129 = 2064 control packet transfers complete and all conditional data transfers complete without DMA errors.
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: The test passes when PHY_STOPSTATE confirms all lanes in stop state. All 2064 control packet DMA transfers (16 VCs x 129 iterations) must complete as indicated by DMA interrupt bit 0. All conditional CSI data DMA transfers must complete as indicated by DMA interrupt bit 1. No unexpected interrupt conditions should be reported.
Remarks: Two hardcoded addresses (0xa0243ffc for UVM signaling and 0xE6001000 for control data readback) could not be resolved from the provided register specifications. DMA registers are accessed via runtime variable gdma_reg_base plus offset tokens (MIPI_CSI2_DMA_INTEN_OFFSET MIPI_CSI2_DMA_INTMIS_OFFSET MIPI_CSI2_DMA_INTCLR_OFFSET) and a hardcoded offset 0x28. The null_blank register at RB_REG base + 0x38 enables null and blanking data transfer path.
